cues: On a reaction coordinate diagram, the slowest step has the highest barrier: the loss of water to form the carbocation.
The carbocation sits in a shallow well, a real but short lived intermediate.
And because tertiary carbocations are the most stable, tertiary alcohols dehydrate most easily: tertiary, then secondary, then primary.
